execution.progress: One stroke per paid round, at most 4 per segment; the work, the reserved piece, its end and the pinned abrasive persist.

details.costs: Study: 4 rounds. inspect: 1 round, 0.5 energy; target an own wooden item or tool and/or x, y a soil point in reach. shape: target an own unreserved rigid wooden item; quantity in tenths (default the item, at most 1 unit, one piece); abrasive: a rigid inedible noncombustible surface in reach, e.g. a rock, or your own whole piece of it on firm ground; both pinned to one work (workId). Each stroke: 1 round, 1 energy; at most 4 per segment; resume continues paused work. maintain: the same strokes on your own shaped or broken tool. use: target your shaped tool; x, y a soil point in reach; load 0.05-1 (default 0.25); 1 round, 1 energy. quoteOnly true quotes shape or maintain free. pause, resume, cancel: no energy. Refusals cost nothing; failed rechecks pause work free. Travel and getting a stone are separate.
details.effects: A whole branch unit is a 0.04 m by 0.99 m green-wood rod; a piece is that part of it. A stroke is 100 passes; by the scratch rule a surface no harder than the other loses 0.0001 kg per pass, so the end loses up to 0.01 kg as dust beside you (piece plus dust equals input). The end tapers over 3 diameters; release needs a tip at most 0.35 diameter and a 0.3 m shaft (a whole branch: about 7 strokes). A shaped tool is unverified until a stroke moves soil. A use stroke presses and levers 30 times at load x 500 N: the tip enters forest or meadow soil until the soil resistance (higher when drier) bears it and moves up to 0.001 m3 of the patch's loose top 0.15 m into a heap beside it; rock, wet bank, waterlogged soil and water move 0. Ground contact wears 0.0001 kg off the tip. Above strength (hardness/10, half if split) the end splits, then breaks. Cancel returns the piece as it is; death leaves it at the worksite. No edge, fire, water, binding, gathering bonus or reward.

All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id.
